name: Rows
description: A collection of Row objects that represent the rows in a table.
example:
Dim i As Integer

With ActivePresentation.Slides(2).Shapes(4).Table

    For i = 1 To .Rows.Count

        .Rows.Height = 160

    Next i

End With

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the specified collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single Row object from the specified Rows collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number of the single Row object in the collection to be returned.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Returns a Row object that represents a row being added to a table.

parameters.name: BeforeRow
parameters.description: The row before which the row is to be added.
